<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>false</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_snc_insurance_0_claim</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Create Documents for New Claim</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    var requiredDocs = {
        motor: [
            'claim_form',
            'police_report',
            'repair_invoice',
            'id_proof'
        ],
        health: [
            'claim_form',
            'medical_report',
            'id_proof'
        ],
        property: [
            'claim_form',
            'property_photos',
            'id_proof'
        ],
        travel: [
            'claim_form',
            'incident_report',
            'travel_itinerary',
            'id_proof'
        ]
    };

    var claimType = current.getValue('claim_type');
    var docs = requiredDocs[claimType];

    if (!docs) {
        return;
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < docs.length; i++) {
        var doc = new GlideRecord(
            'x_snc_insurance_0_document'
        );

        doc.initialize();
        doc.setValue('claim_id', current.getUniqueValue());
        doc.setValue('document_type', docs[i]);
        doc.setValue('upload_status', 'missing');
        doc.insert();
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 06:53:43</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>1809827410e303107f44d87afb0d4340</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Create Documents for New Claim</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Insurance Claim Processing Hub" source="x_snc_insurance_0">0d755344b9a303107f4438bce96291f7</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Insurance Claim Processing Hub">0d755344b9a303107f4438bce96291f7</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_1809827410e303107f44d87afb0d4340</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-24 05:12:38</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=1809827410e303107f44d87afb0d4340"/></record_update>
